applied.description: Full leak sweep: no YAML frontmatter, no scaffold H2s, no [I-n] references, no [[interim-*]] / comparisons / synthesis-plan wikilinks, no pipeline vocabulary in prose. All 11 quoted spans checked and each is an attributed source string (YouTube payout line, 'surprisingly constant between tiers', the 6-12 months advice quote, the Niconico and podcast survey option strings, the Goldman exhibit source line, 'Creator Economy Research Institute'). Nothing stripped; nothing to strip.

Removed section 1C 'Documented analogues' (heading + paragraph: Wikipedia newcomer survival, Debian maintainer half-life). The query restricts scope to 'content creation as an occupation' and requires platform + country per figure; unpaid Wikipedia editors and Debian package maintainers are a different population with no platform/country field. Highest-value length cut with the least on-query loss.

Cut prose that narrates a table cell the reader can already see: the Awin two-waves sentence in 4A (the 78%-restated-as-87% fact stays in the 4A table row); 'the unit is the account' in the Twitch-leak constraints (Unit column); ', a floor above zero' after Regner's $31 (the >$0 floor is stated in the same clause and in the 2A table).

Cut second corroborating examples where the first already carries the sub-claim and the cut figure is not the sole evidence for anything the query asked about: the top-2,000 Twitch sponsorship-link counts in 2C (the 60.6% YouTube off-platform figure carries 'concentrates upward'); the Twitch 21-concurrent-viewer selection floor in 6A (the ILO and World Bank concessions carry survivorship bias); the SD-exceeds-mean clause in 2D (mean/median ratios in 2A establish skew far more precisely).

Deleted section-narrating sentences that forecast what the next subsection would say: 'Set against it are four models of who actually keeps going, and the two literatures do not agree' (4 intro, duplicated by 4B's opener); 'Four failure modes recur, and two sources encountered here carry entirely fabricated apparatus' (6 intro, duplicated by 6D); 'Applying one standard gives an asymmetric result:' (6C, the table's last row states it); 'Beyond the four metadata fields carried by every figure here,' (6B self-reference to the report's own apparatus).

Tightened non-informative phrasing throughout, no figure or metadata touched: 'Five disclosure channels were checked and none carries' to 'carry no'; 'The platform meanwhile switches monetization off' to 'Monetization switches off'; 'for what it presents as one 2019 cohort' to 'for a single presented 2019 cohort'; 'Kuaishou's Hong Kong prospectus' to 'Kuaishou's prospectus'; the Kassi range clause; 'One summary sentence is defensible with its scoping inline' to 'One summary is defensible, scoped inline'; 'cannot be converted into a per-creator quantity at all' to 'resists conversion to'; 'and must not be applied to income figures as one'; 'computed only over creators still present to answer' (the sentence already opens 'describe survivors'); 'so an average describes almost nobody'; 'its three candidate definitions are separately gated and largely decoupled'; the two-sentence merge in the lede.

Split the 6D paragraph before 'One further figure resists conversion...' so the fabricated-apparatus material and the aggregates-without-denominators material are separate paragraphs, matching the subsection title. Removed the difference-in-differences gloss in section 3 only (the regression-discontinuity and Cox-model glosses are retained, so each method type is still explained once).

escalations.issue: Landed at ~5,852 words from 6,133 (-281), measured by per-edit token ledger rather than a word-count tool (tool lock is Read + Edit only, so no wc). That is ~148 words under the 6,000 hard ceiling. If the gate's own counter reads higher than mine by more than ~140 words, the next-cheapest cuts with no protected content in them are, in order: 'Both pass a metadata-only screen; neither passes a reference-list check.' (6D, 11 words, restates the two sentences before it); the Vietnamese-language-coverage sentence in 5D (18 words); the Internet Archive census coverage-bias clause in 6E (18 words).

Section 1 now has subsections A and B only (C removed as off-population). Six required H2s are untouched, verbatim and in order. Flagging in case the structural mirror expects a specific H3 count under section 1.

No mismatch found. All four measurable domains are answered with their absences stated where the record is empty, every figure retains sample size / year / platform / country, and the US/Western-only flag is carried both in section 5A and inline throughout. Nothing in this pass touched a protected item from the do-not-cut list: no table row, no metadata field, no audited absence, neither provenance chain, no nine-country percentage, no inference-labelled sentence, the three income medians with their inclusion floors, the 2B concentration/Gini paragraph, the 0.043%-to-0.43% re-cut sentence (verbatim), and the 4A Platform column all survive intact.
